title: Why Old Dogs Might Be Able to Teach Alzheimer’s Researchers New Tricks - Nautilus
gist: Neurotoxicologist Julie Moreno argues Alzheimer's research is hampered because the disease starts about two decades before symptoms prompt diagnosis, pushing researchers onto mouse models; the excerpt frames aging dogs as a potentially better model.
